Lotus Root 12.4.14 · 16 Nov 2026

Thin mode, explorer paging, safer RPC behind a proxy

⬇ Download 12.4.14What is newQuick start
ImportantNapoleon, 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC: every node must run 12.4.13 or later by then. This version qualifies.
WarningKnown issue, fixed in 12.4.15: these binaries cannot create or load an SQLite wallet, and a node started with -wallet= on such a wallet does not start. If you use the wallet, install 12.4.15.

Highlights

  • Thin mode. -thin=1 runs a node without the history: it proves the coins it needs from peers and checks them against the header chain. -thin=utxo starts from a UTXO snapshot.
  • UTXO snapshots. Full nodes write a snapshot every 100 blocks, once its commitment is buried in the chain, and serve the newest one for download.
  • Explorer. Address history with cursor paging, and batch endpoints for transactions and addresses.
  • Security. JSON-RPC and the operator routes refuse a request that arrives through a reverse proxy, unless you set -rpcallowforwarded=1.
  • Dashboard. A second polish pass of the node's web interface.

Compatibility and rollback

Consensus rulesnone. The rules and the activation time are those of 12.4.13
Minimum version on the network12.4.13, required from Napoleon (2026-12-21 20:50 UTC)
NapoleonEvery node must run 12.5.1 or later before 2026-12-21 20:50 UTC. This version does not.
UpgradingStop the node, replace the binaries, start it. The data directory is kept.
Going backStop the node and put the previous binaries back. Going back is not always possible once a newer version has written to the data directory; the release says when.

Install and verify

Docker 
docker pull ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.4.14
docker run -d --name lotusd -v lotus-data:/data ghcr.io/lotusdevorg/lotusd:12.4.14
Linux 
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.4.14/SHA256SUMS
curl -fsSLO https://github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases/releases/download/v12.4.14/lotus-binaries-12.4.14-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
sha256sum -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS     # must print: OK
tar -xzf lotus-binaries-12.4.14-linux-x86_64.tar.gz
./lotus-binaries-12.4.14-linux-x86_64/lotusd -version
macOS

The same steps with lotus-binaries-12.4.14-macos-x86_64.tar.gz; check with shasum -a 256 -c --ignore-missing SHA256SUMS. macOS asks for confirmation before the first launch (the binaries are not notarised).

Windows

Download lotus-binaries-12.4.14-windows-x86_64.zip and SHA256SUMS. In PowerShell, Get-FileHash .\lotus-binaries-12.4.14-windows-x86_64.zip -Algorithm SHA256 must give the value on that file's line. Then unzip.

Download Lotus binaries from github.com/LotusDevOrg/lotusd-releases only, and check them against SHA256SUMS.
